name: stack3-vscode
description: Scan a repo before you open it: auto-run files, install scripts, malicious packages and leaked secrets.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Stack3 never runs workspace code; it only reads files as data.

stack3.apiUrl.markdownDescription: Stack3 API origin (HTTPS). Empty means the API is not configured and package checks are reported as not checked.

stack3.dev.allowLocalhost.description: Allow http://localhost as the API origin (development only).

stack3.explain.provider.markdownDescription: Where the plain-English explanation of a verdict comes from. `claude` asks Claude Haiku with your own API key (run *Stack3: Set Claude API key*); the redacted findings go to Anthropic. `api` asks the Stack3 server. The explanation never changes the verdict.

stack3.explain.sendSnippets.description: When to send redacted flagged snippets to the AI explanation service.

stack3.report.mode.description: When to report attacker wallets and domains to the Stack3 threat graph.

stack3.scan.limits.description: Scan bounds. Exceeding any bound gives an "unknown" verdict.

stack3.scan.exclude.markdownDescription: Paths to leave out of Stack3's scan of one folder you open, for example your own test fixtures. A map from the folder's full path to a list of paths inside it, such as `{"/home/me/proj": ["test/fixtures", "dist"]}`. Only that exact folder is affected, only guard scans use it (never *Clone and scan safely*), and the verdict says that some paths were not checked. Set it in your user settings only: a repo's own settings cannot change it.

scripts.test:integration: node test/integration/run.mjs && node test/integration/run.mjs webview-xss && node test/integration/run.mjs open-canary
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && vsce package --no-dependencies --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mdimran29/stack3-vscode-assets/main
scripts.publish:marketplace: npm run build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && vsce publish --no-dependencies --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mdimran29/stack3-vscode-assets/main
scripts.publish:openvsx: npm run build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs && npx --yes ovsx@0.10.1 publish --no-dependencies
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && npm run check:regexes && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
